4709-brewster-s-millions.title: Brewster'S Millions
4709-brewster-s-millions.creator: Unknown
4709-brewster-s-millions.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Worldly women were interested in him because he was the only grandson of Edwin Peter Brewster, who was many times a millionaire, and Monty was fairly certain to be his heir--barring an absent-minded gift to charity. Younger women were interested for a much more obvious and simple reason: they liked him.

arxiv-2205-09610.title: Way down in the hole… and up again
arxiv-2205-09610.creator: Valentin Boyanov
arxiv-2205-09610.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Valentin Boyanov. I argue that an approach which uses an appropriate admixture of both classical and semiclassical effects is essential for understanding the ultimate fate of gravitational collapse and the nature of black holes. I provide an example of a problem which pushes the boundaries of what is known in both the classical and semiclassical approaches: the evolution of the inner horizon of a black hole. I show that solving this problem requires considering perturbations of both classical and semiclassical origin.

arxiv-2302-10874.title: Neutralized Local Entropy and dimension bounds for invariant measures Thanks: ⋆ Department of Mathematics, Eberly College of Science, Pennsylvania State University, snir.benovadia@psu.edu † Department of Mathematics, Eberly College of Science, Pennsylvania State University, fjr11@psu.edu
arxiv-2302-10874.creator: S. Ben Ovadia ⋆ , F. Rodriguez-Hertz †
arxiv-2302-10874.description: Abstract . We introduce a notion of a point-wise entropy of measures (i.e local entropy) called neutralized local entropy , and compare it with the Brin-Katok local entropy. We show that the neutralized local entropy coincides with Brin-Katok local entropy almost everywhere. Neutralized local entropy is computed by measuring open sets with a relatively simple geometric description.

arxiv-2412-07593.title: Steering Non-Equilibrium Molecular Dynamics in Optical Cavities
arxiv-2412-07593.creator: Mingxuan Xiao 1, Wei Wang 1, Wenjing Liu 1,3, Zheng Li 1,3, Shui-Jing Tang 2, Yun-Feng Xiao 1,3
arxiv-2412-07593.description: Abstract Optical resonators have shown outstanding abilities to tailor chemical landscapes through enhanced light-matter interaction between confined optical modes and molecule vibrations. We propose a theoretical model to study cooperative vibrational strong coupling in an open quantum system. The non-equilibrium stochastic molecular dynamics in an optical cavity with an auxiliary ensemble is investigated.

arxiv-2504-01115.title: Pion Gravitational Form Factors in Holographic QCD
arxiv-2504-01115.creator: Mitsuru Tanaka, Daisuke Fujii, Akihiro Iwanaka
arxiv-2504-01115.description: Abstract We present the first calculation of the momentum-transfer dependence of the pion gravitational form factors (GFFs) within a top-down holographic QCD framework. These form factors encode essential information about the internal stress distribution of hadrons and may serve as a tool to explore the non-perturbative dynamics responsible for quark and gluon confinement in QCD.

arxiv-2509-25545.title: Performance and competence intertwined: A computational model of the Null Subject stage in English-speaking children
arxiv-2509-25545.creator: Soumik Dey, William Gregory Sakas
arxiv-2509-25545.description: Abstract The empirically established null subject (NS) stage, lasting until about 4 years of age, involves frequent omission of subjects by children. Orfitelli and Hyams 2012 observe that young English speakers often confuse imperative NS utterances with declarative ones due to performance influences, promoting a temporary null subject grammar.

pmc-10644696.title: Cultural inclusivity and diversity in dementia friendly communities: An integrative review
pmc-10644696.creator: Eman Shatnawi, Genevieve Z. Steiner-Lim, Diana Karamacoska
pmc-10644696.description: People with dementia from culturally and linguistically diverse backgrounds often face poor health and social outcomes such as stigma, depression, and reduced help seeking behaviours. Dementia friendly communities have been shown to reduce stigma, and the gap in health and social outcomes for people impacted by dementia.

pmc-10962675.title: Biological and clinical significance of the AGE-RAGE axis in the aggressiveness and prognosis of prostate cancer
pmc-10962675.creator: Shih-Hong Khoo, Pei-Ru Wu, Kun-Tu Yeh, Shih-Lan Hsu, Chi-Hao Wu
pmc-10962675.description: Dietary factors and chronic hyperglycemia are linked to the formation of advanced glycation end products (AGEs) and prostate cancer (PCa) risk. The activation of the receptor for AGEs (RAGE) acts as a bridge between various RAGE ligands and certain malignancies.

pmc-11605566.title: 10058- COT-7 EFFICACY AND CHALLENGES REVEALED BY A SURVEY ON CANCER GENOME PROFILING IN BRAIN TUMORS
pmc-11605566.creator: Shinichiro Koizumi, Tomoya Oishi, Tomohiro Yamasaki, Satoshi Kida, Kazuhiko Kurozumi
pmc-11605566.description: INTRODUCTIONCancer genomic profiling (CGP) testing has become increasingly important in the WHO2021 classification, supporting molecular diagnosis and providing new approaches to personalized treatment and prevention. However, challenges remain regarding the specific impact on personalized treatment and hereditary tumor diagnosis, as well as the current medical service provision system.

pmc-12473096.title: Mechanisms of Self-Assembly of Giant Unilamellar Vesicles in the Army Liposome Formulation (ALF) Family of Vaccine Adjuvants
pmc-12473096.creator: Calin Nicolescu, Essie Komla, Mangala Rao, Gary R. Matyas, Carl R. Alving
pmc-12473096.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background/Objectives: Army Liposome Formulation with QS21 (ALFQ) is a vaccine adjuvant formulation consisting of liposomes that contain saturated zwitterionic and anionic phospholipids, 55 mol% cholesterol, and small molar amounts of monophosphoryl lipid A (MPLA) and QS21 saponin as adjuvants. A unique aspect of ALFQ is that after addition of QS21 to nanoliposomes (<100 nm), the liposomes self-assemble through fusion to form giant (≥1000 nm) unilamellar vesicles (GUVs).

pmc-12514661.title: External Ventricular Drain Column Height Fails to Explain Cerebrospinal Fluid Drainage Volumes
pmc-12514661.creator: Yuan Li, Shripal Gunna, Amber Salter, Yohan Kim, DaiWai M. Olson
pmc-12514661.description: BackgroundAn external ventricular drain (EVD) facilitates cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) diversion and intracranial pressure (ICP) monitoring. CSF drainage can be regulated by controlling the fluid drain height. There is limited evidence guiding nursing practice for adjusting drain height when caring for patients with an EVD.

pmc-12649341.title: Alpha-Tocopherol Protects Porcine Oocytes from Acetamiprid-Induced Meiotic Defects by Alleviating Oxidative Stress-Mediated Ferroptosis
pmc-12649341.creator: Yanhong Liu, Yijing He, Miaoyu Chen, Qinfeng Sun, Biao Zhang, Genkui Zhang, Aiqiao Cao, Qiao Li, Weihan Wang, Shiqiang Ju, Joel R Drevet, Ana B Rodríguez Moratinos
pmc-12649341.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Acetamiprid (ACE), a widely used neonicotinoid insecticide, has raised concerns due to its potential reproductive toxicity. While its adverse effects on animal reproductive systems have been documented, the impact of ACE on mammalian oocytes remains poorly understood. This study aimed to investigate the potential effects of ACE exposure on porcine oocytes and evaluate whether alpha-tocopherol (α-TOC), a fat-soluble antioxidant, could alleviate ACE-induced oocyte damage.

pmc-13157500.title: Synthesis of sialylated human milk oligosaccharides by automated glycan assembly
pmc-13157500.creator: Yan-Ting Kuo, Kim Le Mai Hoang, Peter H Seeberger
pmc-13157500.description: Sialic acids cap the ends of many glycan chains and play pivotal roles in cell signaling, immunity, and pathogen interactions. However, the fast synthesis of sialylated glycans by automated glycan assembly (AGA) has remained a long-standing challenge. Here we show a general strategy that leverages macrobicyclic sialic acid building blocks to achieve reliable α(2,3)- and α(2,6)-sialylation on solid support.
